details:
Some games I've played in VRChat changes the player's avatar to make the game function as intended. Some of the games I've seen use this feature are Overseer by Jar, Nightshift by Chaotic_Jay and the Sword Art game by Zerithax. As a player, this feature often is a little annoying to have to put my avatar back on later. As a creator, I can see how some game ideas might get to be a headache for players by switching them to multiple avatars and filling their recents.

My idea for a solution to this is to make an option in the SDK. When you set up an avatar change in unity, there is an option in the inspector to make the avatar temporary. It sets a flag (bool) and keeps the avatar id of the player's original avatar saved. By changing into the avatar this way, where it sets this flag, it does not record the new avatar into recently used avatars. The new avatar can still be favorited and put on at a later time where it can also then be recorded into the recently used. When the player leaves the world, the flag is removed and the original avatar is reapplied. The same thing could happen if you get to a certain point in a game, removing the flag and reapplying the original avatar. The flag could also remain across different avatars, letting the player be changed into multiple different avatars while still keeping the original avatar id saved.

Examples of how this could work is returning the player to their original model after a night ends in Nightshift, returning the player to their original model when they get selected to overseer in Overseer, or returning to the original avatar once the game finishes loading in Sword Art Online.

Or some original ideas? An infection gamemode where players get turned into a zombie that blends in with the NPC zombies and being returned to their original model when they become uninfected. A prop hunt game mode that turns you into a prop, returning to the original model when you get caught. A team death match game where players are put into a model matching their team colors to avoid confusion.
title: Temporary avatar changing
